name: JW Marriott, Anaheim Resort
insider_take: This sleek tower rises above the Anaheim Resort District like a luxury beacon, offering stunning views of Disneyland's nightly fireworks from select rooms—no theme park ticket required.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Anaheim Resort sits just steps from Disneyland's main entrance, making it one of the closest luxury hotels to the magic. The property features California's largest hotel rooftop pool deck and houses the exclusive JW Lounge on the 20th floor—the highest hotel bar in Orange County with panoramic views stretching to the Pacific Ocean on clear days.
pro_tip: Book a Fireworks View room on floors 15-20 facing northeast for the best unobstructed views of Disneyland's spectacular nightly shows, especially during peak seasons when extended fireworks displays light up the sky.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool experience at sunset, followed by craft cocktails at JW Lounge while watching the 9:30 PM Disneyland fireworks. The hotel's direct connection to GardenWalk shopping center also provides exclusive dining and entertainment options without leaving the resort bubble.
pros: Prime location within walking distance to Disneyland and Disney California Adventure
Luxurious accommodations with premium amenities and elegant design
Multiple dining options including upscale restaurants and casual eateries
Family-friendly resort with pools, spa, and recreational facilities
cons: Busy location during peak Disney seasons
